description: PROP-E5 fixture corpus explicitly mandates 'ALSO asserts ZERO calls to security find-generic-password, ZERO Telegram POSTs, ZERO gh-issue creates with escalation-class labels — these would all be regressions of the v7 NO HUMAN invariant'. test_spawn_pin.py has 12 fixture cases (f-i..f-xii) but NO meta-assertion against the v7 NO HUMAN regression set. The only place anti-human-touch is checked is test_group_j.py's static-analyzer test corpus, which exercises anti_human_touch_violations on synthetic input strings — not on the actual lib/* source tree. There is no integration test that scans the entire skills/_shared/ tree with anti_human_touch_violations to prove the production codebase itself is clean. This is exactly the kind of static-analysis check the spec says adversary-daily would run, but the runner is missing (see FIND-001) and there is no equivalent guard.

evidence.snippet: PROP-E5 row: 'The integration test ALSO asserts ZERO calls to security find-generic-password, ZERO Telegram POSTs, ZERO gh-issue creates with escalation-class labels' — no such assertion in test_spawn_pin.py.
